Name: A slightly better looking TV channel
Author: EtaMyosotis
Description:
[size=3]I don't like the original TV channel, so I simply made this one.

There are two versions of Livin' Off The Land, grandpa and vanilla.When you choose grandpa, he'll burrow into your TV and explain farming to you!

I repainted all of Welwick's faces, including the casino and Stardew Valley Fair. If she's appeared elsewhere and I haven't added compatibility, please report back to me.

[s]I've also made a compatibility patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23135]Cloudy Skies[/url], which I'll put in the optional file when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/138772588]KhloeLeclair[/url] gives me permission to post it.[/s]
I have released the compatibility patch! I'm very sorry I'm not sure how to replace files in other mods with CP, so this compatibility patch is in replacement form. Just use it to overwrite the original images in Cloudy Skies.


The options are all configurable. There should be no bugs. if you run into any problems, please report them to me![/size]
